BiblicalUsage: Binnui means built up, and the name belongs to several Levites in the days of Ezra and Nehemiah. Ezra 10:30 names a Binnui among those who put away foreign wives, Nehemiah 3:24 shows Binnui the son of Henadad repairing another piece of the wall, and Nehemiah 10:9 lists Binnui among the Levites who sealed the covenant. Note that the Hebrew text numbers the covenant verse one higher than the King James text does.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a name meaning built up, carried by men who rebuilt the wall and sealed the covenant, is a name that fits its owners.
